Auth.signInDescription: Enter your email and password to access household transactions.
Auth.noHouseholdDescription: This user account is not linked to any household in the system yet.

Transactions.sectionDescription: Record expenses, income, and transfers between owned accounts while preserving financial rules.

form.amountHelp: Enter amount in decimal format (e.g. 123.45 or 100). Both dot and comma are accepted.
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the transaction.
form.transferInvariantNotice: Per financial rules, an internal transfer is neither income nor spending and does not change total household funds (INV-001).
form.transferRequiresTwoAccounts: At least two accounts are required in the household to record a transfer.
form.transferSameAccountError: Source and destination accounts must be different.
form.transferCurrencyMismatchError: Transfers are only supported between accounts with the same currency.
form.transferNoMatchingCurrency: No other account shares the same currency as the selected source account.
form.noAccounts: No accounts in the household yet. Please add an account to record transactions.
form.amountRequired: Enter a valid positive amount greater than zero (e.g. 123.45).
